body:
# ⚠️ ABSOLUTE ANARCHY — NO ANTICHEAT

Welcome to the official page for this project. This is a pure, unfiltered, and 100% anarchy environment with no gameplay rules, no admins, and no anticheat systems.

## 🚀 About the Project

This project was created for players who want to experience Minecraft at the absolute limit of its possibilities. There are no software barriers. Anything your client can send to the server is permitted.

### ✨ Key Features
* **🔥 No Anticheat:** No GrimAC, no Vulcan, no Matrix. The server does not block packets, movement, or interactions.
* **💎 Vanilla Core:** The world runs on a stable version, maximizing the retention of vanilla mechanics and exploits.
* **🗺️ Endless Freedom:** The map has no boundaries (WorldBorder), no spawn protection, and no chat rules.
* **🛠️ Optimized Backend:** We utilize modern architecture to ensure stable TPS even under heavy load and chunk glitching.

---

## ⚙️ Hosting & Infrastructure

* **Current Platform:** The server currently runs on **Aternos**. 
* **Future Upgrades:** As community support and player count grow, we plan to migrate the project to a **dedicated, high-performance hosting platform** to ensure better uptime and stability.

---

## ⚠️ Player Disclaimer

* **Everything is Allowed:** Griefing, stealing, hacking, exploiting duplication glitches (duping), and building lag machines are all part of the gameplay loop.
* **No Map Resets:** The world is permanent. The history of the spawn and all player bases will remain etched into the terrain forever.
